title: Degreewise local stalk-map representatives
statement: Let Y be a scheme, P and Q cochain complexes of O_Y-modules whose terms are zero or finite free, y a point, and t an arbitrary family of morphisms between the terms pulled back along Y.fromSpecStalk y. For each degree n there is an open neighbourhood U of y and a map g between the restricted terms whose pullback is E_U(P).hom_n ; t_n ; E_U(Q).inv_n, for the canonical stalkRestrictionComplexIso E_U. No boundedness or chain equation is required.

source.place: lem-pc-finite-free-stalk-chain-map-lift-local, steps 1--2, finite coefficient extension before imposing differential equations; expansion of the finite matrix calculation of lem-pc-perfect-locus

proof.text: Introduce the degree n. In either zero-term case, Functor.map_isZero makes t n zero (IsZero.eq_of_src/eq_of_tgt); choose the zero map on the top open.
For two nonzero terms choose the finite free isomorphisms eP and eQ. Apply the canonical-free extension lemma to F.map eP.inv ; t n ; F.map eQ.hom, where F is stalk pullback.

Conjugate the resulting local map by R.map eP.hom and R.map eQ.inv. The component of stalkRestrictionComplexIso is definitionally the module comparison E. Naturality of E.hom and E.inv and the two basis inverse identities prove the required component equation.

proof_origin.place: Second-reader reduction: zero terms, canonical finite-free extension, basis conjugation and comparison naturality

theorem exists_local_degreewise_of_stalk_local
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P Q : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (hPfree : ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero (P.X n) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (hQfree : ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero (Q.X n) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (y : Y)
    (t : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj Q).X n) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ (U : Y.Opens), ∃ (hyU : y ∈ U), ∃ (g :
      (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q).X n),
      (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map g =
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app P).hom.f n ≫ t n ≫
          ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app Q).inv.f n
